title: Neighbouring camp with Walter DeCue and Red Dugard
summary: Next door to Moreau's, Walter DeCue and Red Dugard played, all old-time musicians.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: They had a piano next door to us, Walter DeCue was playing. That was the name of the place next to Moro. No, not the Stoops. Right next to Moro. Yeah. Walter DeCue was playing piano.

I don't remember the name, but I know what you mean. I can show you. I can show you right now. I forgot the name. I really forgot the name of it. They had a... But it wasn't far from us. I mean, we could look at them, I mean, from where they was, it's about half a block. We could look at them, I mean, through the screen playing, they could look at us. At that time, Walter DeCue and... Walter DeCue and... The Dugard, the Dugard, they used to play drums, Red Dugard. They was out there at that time. Them's all old, old musicians, what I'm talking about. You heard of Red Dugard?
